name: The Flying General
source:
Old crumbling buildings, decaying asphalt roads, and miraculously still working motorcycles are the backbone of this new society that rose from the ashes of the apocalypse that wiped out the great civilizations of the past. 

The world has gone to hell. Wouldn't it be the cruelest irony if paradise was just a breath away, forever out of reach?

[From [url=https://loudo.itch.io/the-flying-general]Itch.io[/url]]
